product.name: AI Job Search & Fit Scorer
product.outcome: Inspect an evidence-backed shortlist of up to five developer-job evaluations for one fictional candidate profile.

datedPublicReadback.proofBoundary: Public metadata and build state only; this read did not execute a search or score, prove source health, settle billing, or deliver a shortlist.

sample.note: Contract-valid scored row from historical nomad-agent predecessor evidence. It is useful for schema interpretation, not current Job Atlas execution proof.
notProofOf: the current Job Atlas Actor output

completion.sourceRule: Every fit row must validate as nomad-ai-job-fit-v1; row.source and row.job.identity.source must agree, and source provenance must reconcile with the summary.
completion.retryRule: Do not start another run automatically. Internal source attempts are governed by the fit-summary contract; any new Actor run needs separate approval.
completion.costRule: Require settled job-fit-result accounting and v4 result-policy arithmetic. At most five retained shortlist rows cost up to $0.10 at the observed unit price; fewer or zero rows can be valid, and $0.10 is a ceiling.

guidance.expectedOutput: Zero to five nomad-ai-job-fit-v1 shortlist rows with fit and delivery scores, hard-gate evidence, gaps, source provenance, and candidate-specific matchKey.
guidance.unknownFields: Missing evidence remains a gap or null; a fit score is not a probability. Use matchKey, not jobKey alone, for candidate-specific destination identity.
guidance.empty: A contract-valid empty shortlist can mean evaluated jobs were filtered by static or delivery gates. Reconcile counts before calling it clean; it is not proof that the sources had no jobs.
guidance.partial: A partial summary can preserve usable rows while reporting bounded source or scoring limitations. Inspect source statuses, warnings, counts, and budgetLimited.
guidance.failure: Reject non-SUCCEEDED terminal runs, invalid result-policy arithmetic, missing immutable build or storage identities, unbound candidate/source provenance, schema errors, or unsettled count/charge mismatches.
limitations: The Actor evaluates one candidate per run and does not apply to jobs, send alerts, learn from clicks, or make hiring decisions.
Public sources can fail or omit fields, and shortlist mode deliberately filters some evaluations.
Use synthetic or consented candidate data; platform input retention remains governed by Apify controls.
guidance.supportedNextStep: Use the maintained REST runner after validating the exact Actor result; local MCP, n8n, Make, Zapier, Python, and Agent Skill assets remain available for their documented scopes.
guidance.nextStepProof: No hosted MCP exposure, workflow import, active schedule, or named Google Sheets write is proved by this pack.

relatedExecutionEvidence.note: S03 retained a successful default-selector Job Atlas run with one contract-valid row. It did not use this exact input, and its early charge receipt was not final billing proof.

sideEffects: One paid Actor run and retained Apify run, dataset, key-value-store, source receipts, and accounting records.
The input contains a fictional candidate profile; no destination, schedule, webhook, publication, or metadata change.
approvalProposal.rollback: Do not retry, deliver, or publish the result. Preserve the failed receipt for diagnosis; no Actor selector or metadata is changed by this proposal.
